task.intent: Tell me the total number of cancellations of the customer who has the most cancellations in the history

delivered_message.plan:
1. Navigate to the Orders section of the admin dashboard.
2. Filter or sort the order history to identify all orders with a status of "Cancelled".
3. Group these cancelled orders by customer ID or customer name.
4. Count the number of cancellations for each customer.
5. Identify the customer with the highest count.
6. Report that specific count as the total number of cancellations for the customer with the most cancellations.
